featured.label: FEATURED STORY
featured.title: A school kit became a reason to raise her hand.
featured.person: Maya, Grade 5 Student • Sunshine Learning Center
featured.quote: She held her new school bag all morning and refused to put it down. That was the very day she started sitting in the front row and raising her hand.
featured.description: Before joining our neighborhood learning center, Maya shared a single notebook with her two siblings and often missed class when her parents traveled for seasonal work. With her own backpack, bilingual storybooks, and a patient mentor, Maya rose to the top of her reading group and now helps younger students practice phonics every afternoon.
featured.imageAlt: Children holding their new school supply kits

storiesSection.label: COMMUNITY VOICES
storiesSection.title: Change Grows One Story At A Time

stories.title: A classroom that feels like a second home
stories.description: After joining our after-school learning circle, Anita overcame her fear of reading aloud. Today she borrows two storybooks every week and reads to her grandmother every evening.
stories.imageAlt: Children learning together in a classroom

stories.title: From first mouse click to coding a science project
stories.description: Rohan touched a computer for the first time at our Digital Learning Lab. Within eight months, he designed an interactive presentation on solar energy that won his district school fair.

stories.title: First girl in her family to enter high school
stories.description: Supported by our Girls' Education scholarship and weekly mentor circle, Meera passed her Grade 10 board exams with distinction and dreams of becoming a pediatric nurse.
stories.imageAlt: Girls studying together in a classroom

stories.title: When the Mobile Library rolled into the village
stories.description: In a village 18 kilometers from the nearest town library, forty children now gather under the banyan tree every Saturday to exchange books and perform stories.

stories.title: Learning fractions and ecology in the school garden
stories.description: Through our Art & Gardening club, Aarav learned measurement, soil science, and teamwork while helping his classmates grow fresh vegetables for their mid-day meals.
stories.imageAlt: Children tending seedlings in a school garden

stories.title: A local mother becomes a certified community teacher
stories.description: After completing Educare Foundation's teacher training fellowship, Sunita opened an early childhood classroom in her own neighborhood that now nurtures 35 young learners.
stories.imageAlt: Teacher smiling with students in class
